## Common WHERE Filters

分区过滤（所有查询必须）:
```sql
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND tz_type = 'local'
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

业务过滤（按需添加）:
```sql
-- 过滤有效广告
AND ads_status IN (1, 4)

-- 只看特定位置
AND location = 1
```

预算有效期过滤（在 JOIN 后的外层 WHERE 使用）:
```sql
-- 预算未过期
AND substr(cast(budget_end_datetime as string), 0, 11) >= DATE('${grass_date}')

-- 预算已开始且未过期
AND substr(budget_start_datetime, 1, 10) <= '${grass_date}'
AND substr(budget_end_datetime, 1, 10) >= '${grass_date}'
```

手动查询中用 `current_date` 代替参数:
```sql
WHERE grass_date = current_date - interval '1' day
  AND grass_region = 'ID'
  AND location = 1
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### Pattern 1: 获取广告计划元信息 (最常用)

```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ads_id, shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
) dim_ads ON dim_ads.ads_id = fact_table.ads_id
```

### Pattern 2: 多键关联 (手动查询)

```sql
JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live d
  ON b.ads_id = d.ads_id
 AND b.grass_region = d.grass_region
WHERE b.grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND d.grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND d.ads_status IN (1, 4)
```

## Common Aggregations

### 预算汇总

```sql
SELECT ads_id, shop_id, grass_region,
       SUM(budget_local_amt) / 100000 AS budget_local_amt,
       SUM(budget_usd_amt) / 100000 AS budget_usd_amt,
       SUM(estimate_expense_local_amt) / 10000 AS estimate_expense_local,
       SUM(estimate_expense_usd_amt) / 10000 AS estimate_expense_usd
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
  AND grass_date = current_date - interval '1' day
  AND location = 1
GROUP BY ads_id, shop_id, grass_region
```

### CPM 出价 (MAX 取值)

```sql
MAX(estimate_cpm_local) AS cpm_local,
MAX(estimate_cpm_usd) AS cpm_usd
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: Display Ads 收入归因 (dws_advertise_display_ads_revenue)

```sql
SELECT display_ads_traffic.ads_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement,
       shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime,
       impression_cnt,
       round(cpm_local / 100000, 2) AS cpm_local,
       round(cpm_local / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS cpm_usd,
       round(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000, 2) AS expense_amt_local,
       round(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) AS expense_amt_usd,
       click_cnt, campaign_id
FROM (
    SELECT ads_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement, campaign_id, grass_region,
           SUM(impression) AS impression_cnt, SUM(non_fraud_click) AS click_cnt,
           MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_ads_report_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND placement = 9 AND slot_id IS NOT NULL
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
) display_ads_traffic
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ads_id, shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND tz_type = 'local' AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
) display_ads ON display_ads.ads_id = display_ads_traffic.ads_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
    FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
) exchange_rate_info ON display_ads_traffic.grass_region = exchange_rate_info.grass_region
WHERE substr(cast(budget_end_datetime as string), 0, 11) >= DATE('${grass_date}')
```

### Snippet 2: 用户净收入计算 (dws_user_net_ads_revenue_1d)

```sql
display_ads_reveune AS (
    SELECT shop_id, display_ads_traffic.ads_id, user_id,
           entrance, 0 AS sub_entrance, pricing_type, placement, campaign_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date >= DATE('2022-10-26')
                    THEN round(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) / 1000.00
                    ELSE round(cpm_local * impression_cnt / 100000 / exchange_rate, 2) / 100000.00 / 1000.00
               END) AS display_ads_revenue_usd_1d
    FROM (
        SELECT ads_id, user_id, entrance, pricing_type, placement,
               grass_region, campaign_id, grass_date,
               SUM(impression_cnt) AS impression_cnt, MAX(cpm) AS cpm_local
        FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
          AND grass_region = '${upper_region}' AND tz_type = 'local'
          AND placement = 9 AND slot_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
    ) display_ads_traffic
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT ads_id, shop_id, budget_start_datetime, budget_end_datetime
        FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
        WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
          AND grass_region = '${upper_region}' AND tz_type = 'local'
    ) display_ads ON display_ads.ads_id = display_ads_traffic.ads_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT grass_region, exchange_rate
        FROM mp_order.dim_exchange_rate__reg_s0_live
        WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
    ) exchange_rate_info ON display_ads_traffic.grass_region = exchange_rate_info.grass_region
    WHERE substr(budget_start_datetime, 1, 10) <= '${grass_date}'
      AND substr(budget_end_datetime, 1, 10) >= '${grass_date}'
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
)
```

       create_datetime, last_update_datetime,

       SUM(estimate_expense_local_amt) / 10000 AS estimate_expense_local,

### Snippet 5: 广告状态过滤查询 (display_ads_stat)

```sql
-- 直接查单条广告
SELECT *
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE'2022-10-11'
  AND grass_region = 'ID'
  AND ads_id = 109357996

-- JOIN + 状态过滤
SELECT b.grass_region, substr(booked_datetime, 1, 10) AS booked_date,
       COALESCE(SUM(booked_imp_cnt), 0) AS booked_imp_cnt
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dws_brand_booking_eachday_ads_1d__reg_s0_live b
JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_display_ads__reg_s3_live d
  ON b.ads_id = d.ads_id
 AND b.grass_region = d.grass_region
WHERE b.grass_date = DATE_ADD('day', -1, '2022-10-12')
  AND d.grass_date = DATE_ADD('day', -1, '2022-10-12')
  AND d.ads_status IN (1, 4)
GROUP BY 1, 2
```
